entity.summary: Abu Dhabi-based centralized crypto exchange providing AED on-ramps and off-ramps, spot trading, OTC execution, and institutional trading services.
entity.notes: The current first-party site presents active spot trading in AED and USDT pairs, AED funding and withdrawals, OTC execution, and institutional services. The ADGM FSRA public register lists BurjX MENA Ltd. as active under FSP 240022, with matched-principal virtual-asset dealing and custody activities effective from 2025-06-11. No exact platform launch date is inferred from the FSP date, and the regulatory record is not converted into a broader safety or product-quality endorsement.
